:::{#def-prediction-rule}
#### Prediction rule

The **prediction rule** that a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) $g$
produces from a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$
is the function that gives the [prediction](estimation.qmd#def-prediction)
at each covariate value $x$:

$$
\fitted(x) \eqdef g\paren{x; \trainset}.
$$ {#eq-prediction-rule}

:::
